name: memory-lab-2sep
description: One-click Cloudflare Workers memory MCP with stateless client + method-call tracking (D1 only, zero runtime deps)

scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run test

DB.description: D1 stores memories, OAuth clients/codes/tokens, and the stateless client + method-call ledger.

OWNER_PASSPHRASE.description: Owner passphrase. Unlocks the dashboard and approves MCP clients on the OAuth page (claude.ai). Generate: openssl rand -base64 32

API_TOKEN.description: Optional static bearer for Claude Code / Codex / curl. Leave blank to allow OAuth only.
